Karan treats the entire product lifecycle — from database schema design to automation-driven crawling and extraction to responsive 3D interfaces — as one cohesive, optimized system.

SECTION 4: PROJECTS (DETAILED)
================================================================================

--- Project 1: FHMNews ---
Type: Autonomous News Platform
Status: Deployed & Live
Role: Lead Full Stack Engineer
Description:
  Engineered a fully autonomous news platform (FHMNews.com) designed to fetch,
  process, and publish high-quality content via external APIs with minimal manual
  intervention. Built Python-based automation scripts using Selenium and requests
  for seamless ingestion. Developed intelligent blogging systems utilizing Groq API
  and LLMs for automated content generation and dynamic scheduling.
Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, FastAPI, Groq API, Selenium, Vercel

--- Project 2: Socioglamm ---
Type: Dual-Module Social & E-Commerce Platform
Status: Deployed (private company project)
Role: Lead Frontend Developer
Description:
  Architected a dual-module ecosystem using Next.js. Built an E-commerce section
  for partner brand advertising and a Community section featuring video/reel uploads
  to increase user retention. Implemented server-side rendering (SSR) and dynamic
  sitemap generation, ensuring rapid Google indexing and search coverage.
Tech Stack: Next.js, React.js, Redux, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS S3, Socket.io

--- Project 3: Carsnbike ---
Type: Automotive Listing Platform
URL: https://www.carsnbike.com/
Status: Live and active
Role: Full-Stack Developer
Description:
  Developed carsnbike.com, a dynamic listing portal. Engineered location-based
  filtering for cars/bikes, currency swapping (USD / INR), and a blog CMS to track
  automobile industry trends.
Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, AWS EC2/S3, Nginx

--- Project 4: PMEDU4U ---
Type: EdTech Platform
URL: pmedu4u.com
Status: Live
Role: Full-Stack Developer
Description:
  Delivered a full-stack educational platform facilitating student enrollment and
  aptitude testing. Developed an "Interview Preparation Kit" module with simulated
  testing features.
Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB

SECTION 5: LIFE JOURNEY / ROADMAP
================================================================================

2002 — Born in Patna, Bihar, India.
  Childhood marked by curiosity. Spent time exploring how things worked —
  radios, calculators, televisions. A mind wired for systems from day one.

2019 — School Years & Mathematics (Gyan Niketan).
  Completed Matriculation and Intermediate boards at Gyan Niketan with a Physics,
  Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) focus. Realized problem-solving was addictive.

2021 — Galgotias & First Real Code.
  Started Bachelor of Technology in Computer Software Engineering at Galgotias
  University. Deployed my first paid commercial project — a healthcare patient
  scheduling mobile app. Real clients, real users, real stakes.

2023 — Building Complex Products.
  Deep-dived into full-stack scaling, Redis caching, and technical SEO. Developed
  Carsnbike (automotive listing CMS) and PMEDU4U (EdTech testing platform).

2025 — Flyhead Media (Associate Software Engineer).
  Graduated from Galgotias University with a B.Tech in CSE. Joined Flyhead Media
  as a Software Engineer Intern and was promoted to Associate Software Engineer.
  Built Next.js web applications, optimizing build procedures, Redis caching layers,
  and page speeds/Core Web Vitals.

2026 — Creative Volt (Full Stack Engineer & AI Architect).
  Joined Creative Volt in Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab. Architecting full-stack
  systems, writing automation scripts using Selenium and requests, and deploying
  autonomous news platform FHMNews.com with Groq API and LLMs.
